item.title: Hayy Learning | Recess: An After-School Programme for Teens
item.description: Recess is back — and applications are open! An alternative afterschool arts programme at Hayy Jameel for ambitious teens aged 14–17. Over 12 weekly sessions, participants dive into contemporary art through studio practice, research, field trips to local galleries and artist studios and mentorship from working creatives. Every student hand-binds their own portfolio throughout the programme, and the whole cohort comes together at the end for a real, student-led showcase.

item.title: Prince Faisal Bin Fahd Art Exhibition: Summer 2026
item.description: The Prince Faisal Bin Fahd Art Exhibition: Summer 2026 returns in its fourth edition, bringing together a diverse group of Saudi and resident artists under a unifying theme 'Ways of Knowing: Art as Interdisciplinary Research,' that explores societal transformation across generations. The exhibition presents a rich collection of works across multiple mediums—including abstract painting, photography, multimedia installations, and conceptual art—offering contemporary perspectives on Saudi cultural identity and evolving social values. Through creative expression, the exhibition highlights the dialogue between past, present, and future, reflecting the dynamic role of art in shaping and interpreting social change.

item.title: Registration for International Research Competition on Non-Terrestrial Networks
item.description: The Communications, Space and Technology Commission (CST), in partnership with the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE), is organizing the 3rd International Research Competition on Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) 2026. The competition invites researchers, graduate students, and recent PhD graduates from around the world to submit innovative research on non-terrestrial networks, future wireless communications, and the integration of terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks. Selected finalists will present their research during the Global Space Connectivity and Sustainability Events in Riyadh, where the winners will be announced. The competition aims to promote research and innovation in next-generation connectivity technologies and strengthen international collaboration in developing sustainable communications solutions. Register Now

item.title: البرنامج الصيفي بجامعة الجوف 2026
item.description: تطلق جامعة الجوف البرنامج الصيفي بجامعة الجوف 1447هـ – 2026م، بوصفه برنامجًا نوعيًا متكاملًا يستهدف تنمية المهارات وتطويرها، ونشر ثقافة الابتكار، وترسيخ ثقافة التطوع وخدمة المجتمع، بما يعزز دور الجامعة التنموي والمجتمعي، ويفتح مسارات واسعة لاستثمار فترة الصيف في برامج معرفية وتدريبية وتطوعية ورياضية موجهة لمنسوبي الجامعة وطلبتها والخريجين وأفراد المجتمع. ويستهدف البرنامج، الذي يمتد من شهر يوليو حتى نهاية أغسطس 2026م، أكثر من 16,000مستفيد من داخل الجامعة وخارجها، من خلال أكثر من 50 برنامجًا وفعالية نوعية، وما يزيد على 210 ساعة تدريبية مكثفة، إلى جانب مشاركة أكثر من 300 متطوع أكاديمي وطبي، وتنفيذ أكثر من 11,000 ساعة تطوعية معتمدة، إضافة إلى أكثر من 10 بطولات رياضية صيفية.

item.title: Where We Belong
item.description: Look closely at Earth, and it begins to feel like a system that never stops working; air moving, water cycling, living things adapting. In this program, children explore how life continues and changes across different environments, and how organisms adjust to survive over time. The journey then stretches further, looking at how science studies these systems and reimagines them beyond Earth. The experience connects life, environment, and possibility in one continuous story.

item.title: Mishkat Summer Camp
item.description: Discover the exciting world of science, energy, and innovation at Mishkat Summer Camp 2026, where young learners can explore the future through hands-on experiments, interactive challenges, educational games, and collaborative activities designed to inspire curiosity, creativity, and teamwork. Organised by Mishkat Interactive Center, an initiative of the King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (K.A.CARE), the camp introduces participants to the future of energy while developing STEAM skills through experiential learning. Activities explore topics such as solar, wind, and nuclear energy, hydrogen technologies, the circular carbon economy, artificial intelligence, innovation, and programming, supporting Saudi Vision 2030's goals of building future-ready generations. The programme is free of charge and is open to children aged 10–12 years. Camp Schedule Girls: 12–23 July | Boys: 26 July–6 August | Days: Sunday–Thursday Register Now

item.title: SAIF Summer Program
item.description: SAIF 2026 is a summer creative program presented by SAMoCA at JAX, offering a diverse range of workshops, film screenings, and interactive activities for children, teenagers, and young audiences. The program features hands-on experiences in ceramics, fashion and tailoring, papermaking, photography, writing, voiceover, and other creative disciplines. Developed in collaboration with cultural and educational partners, SAIF encourages artistic expression, creativity, and cultural discovery through engaging learning experiences. Hosted at SAMoCA at JAX in the JAX District, Diriyah, the program provides an inspiring environment where visitors can explore Saudi creativity, develop new skills, and participate in a vibrant community of art and culture.

item.title: Connect and Create!
item.description: How can a simple movement extend across an entire form? How does motion travel through connected parts to create a balanced and elegant transformation? Join us in an interactive experience where we explore how linked structures expand and contract to create smooth movement with minimal effort. We build, test and observe how motion spreads through a form to create transforming patterns that bring together science, design and art.

item.title: Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo
item.description: Taking place at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Convention Center, Merath – Middle East Museums & Heritage Expo is the Kingdom’s first dedicated trade event for museums, heritage, and cultural development. The three-day exhibition brings together more than 100 exhibiting companies and over 3,000 visitors, including museums, galleries, science centers, cultural institutions, government entities, private collectors, and heritage developers. Co-located with the Saudi Entertainment and Amusement Expo (SEA Expo) and the Saudi Light and Sound Expo (SLS Expo), Merath provides a strategic platform to connect with decision-makers and explore opportunities within Saudi Arabia’s rapidly expanding $67 billion heritage and museum market, reinforcing Riyadh’s role as a growing hub for cultural innovation and investment.

item.title: The Art of Islamic Illumination
item.description: This 5-day course will take art lovers, painters, calligraphers and traditional art enthusiasts on an engaging journey. This course is essential for participants who enjoy learning about Islamic floral shapes, which consist of stylized botanical forms of leaves and flowers—the foundation of traditional Islamic illumination. In this hands-on course, artists passionate about Islamic art will explore part of the history behind these shapes. They will learn and practice how to paint Islamic flowers on paper using gouache colors and shell gold.
